rationale: No material-regression rule triggered, but at least one predeclared GO requirement lacked support.

predeclared_rules.go: Source-balanced Macro F1 gain >=0.02 absolute or >=5% relative; China Macro F1 decline no greater than 0.02; no pothole-recall decrease in either source; no integrity failure; improvement is broad (at least 10 differing groups and >=60% favor M-UAV1 in each source). A source with fewer than 20 pothole objects is treated as insufficient support for GO.
predeclared_rules.no_go: NO-GO takes precedence if balanced Macro F1 is negative with both sources nonpositive, China Macro F1 drops by >0.02, or pothole recall drops by >0.05 in either source.
predeclared_rules.inconclusive: Neither branch above, including insufficient pothole support or localized/uncertain improvement.
